findings.location: HTML, poem paragraph beginning “At the end of myself”
findings.source_quote: “My precious child, look up.” / “I felt all alone”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Hija preciosa” with a gender-neutral form such as “Criatura preciosa” and replace “me sentí completamente sola” with “me sentí completamente sin compañía,” preserving that the English does not specify the speaker’s gender.
findings.translation_quote: «Hija preciosa, mira hacia arriba». / «…me sentí completamente sola»

findings.location: HTML, poem paragraph beginning “My child, fear not” and final poem paragraph
findings.source_quote: “My child, fear not…” / “So, My child, gaze long at the rainbow.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Hija mía” in both places with a gender-neutral form such as “Criatura mía” so the translation does not assign the speaker a gender that the source leaves unspecified.
findings.translation_quote: «Hija mía, no temas…» / «Así que, hija mía, contempla largamente el arcoíris.»

findings.location: HTML, poem paragraph beginning “Not only was the danger around me”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Sin saber cómo empezar de nuevo” with “Sin saber cómo seguir adelante” to avoid adding the sense of starting over.
